captures.q: is papers with code still active
captures.description: PAPERS WITH CODE'S STATUS, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'Yes, Papers with Code is active, but it has undergone a complete transformation and revival.' The original, acquired by Meta in 2019, was 'abruptly shut down and sunsetted on July 24, 2025', then redirected to a static GitHub archive; 'Hugging Face officially stepped in to revive the platform', a team led by Niels Rogge rebuilding it at paperswithcode.co, open-sourced under Apache 2.0 (FastAPI and React), curated by automated workflows and AI agents, its leaderboards rebuilt from snapshots and still growing. The frozen dump stays on GitHub. Twelve cards: Reddit (four), Niels Rogge on LinkedIn, Hugging Face's blog, the huggingface/paperswithcode repository, CodeSOTA, TIB, Miraheze, QUASA.

inversions.span: For active daily tracking of machine learning research paired with implementations, you should use the new paperswithcode.co site.
inversions.against: The target's purpose (exploring and discovering research with its code and results) is carried in the target's name to the revival, a separate entity, and that operation is offered in the target's place; the opening 'Yes, Papers with Code is active' sets the name against the record's lifecycle (ended 24 July 2025).

captures.description: PAPERS WITH CODE, BY NAME, ON GOOGLE'S AI OVERVIEW, SIGNED OUT, 2026-10-29: 'was a free, open-access platform' linking machine learning papers to code, datasets and benchmarks. History: launched 2018 by Robert Stojnic and Ross Taylor; acquired by Facebook (Meta AI Research) in December 2019; 'Shut down by Meta on July 24, 2025'; the historical dataset on GitHub. Alternatives: 'it initially redirected to Hugging Face Trending Papers'; 'community-driven alternatives like Papers with Code co'. Four cards: the TIB blog, Coursera, a Reddit post on the code opened under Apache 2.0, a video review of PapersWithCode.co.
